name: cyber-buddy-monorepo
description: AI-powered personalized desktop pet Chrome extension (Monorepo)

scripts.build:lambda: npm run build --workspace=backend/lambda/auth && npm run build --workspace=backend/lambda/pets && npm run build --workspace=backend/lambda/activities
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:lambda && npm run build --workspace=backend/infrastructure
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:extension && npm run build:backend
scripts.deploy: npm run build:lambda && npm run cdk:deploy
scripts.clean: rm -rf extension/node_modules backend/*/node_modules shared/node_modules node_modules extension/.output backend/lambda/*/dist backend/infrastructure/dist backend/infrastructure/cdk.out
